summary: Completed the initial schema-version-2 review of Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A common stock after the 2026-07-30 lower-Bollinger transition. Q2 2026 platform assets, net deposits, customers, subscriptions, revenue and adjusted EBITDA grew strongly, but cryptocurrency revenue fell 38%, operating expenses rose 33%, credit-loss expense doubled, and USD 129 million of quarterly net income came primarily from deconsolidating RVI. The 20.29% July 1-30 decline ended in only a marginal lower-band breach, which had reversed by July 31, so the alert is valuation and cyclicality risk rather than an oversold entry. At the USD 86.56 mark, bounded USD 42.40/69.00/112.50 bear/base/bull values produce a USD 73.225 probability-weighted value, -15.41% expected return and -11.55% confidence-adjusted expected return. The deterministic assessment is Sell/Avoid and allocation-ineligible. No strategy or idea follow-up was created.

It also reports higher costs, credit-loss expense, stock compensation and material market-maker concentration.

Robinhood's SEC-hosted Q2 release reports 32% revenue growth, USD 741 million adjusted EBITDA, 28.4 million funded customers, USD 368.7 billion total platform assets, USD 21.7 billion quarterly net deposits and 4.84 million Gold subscribers. Cryptocurrency revenue fell 38%, operating expenses rose 33%, and USD 129 million of net income came primarily from the RVI deconsolidation gain.
